messages:
emily: Hi all — returning from parental leave and want to do a 4-week phased ramp starting 2026-08-02. Plan: week1 40% (Mon/Wed mornings), week2 60%, week3 80%, week4 100. Also need to be in Ireland for 8 days during week2 for family visa appointment. What do I need to file and how does this affect pay/benefits?

marc (People Ops): Congrats, Emily! Please submit the Phased Return form under HR > Leaves & Return and complete the Remote Work Abroad mini-form with exact Ireland dates and device info. We need manager sign-off + People Ops approval.

emily: Is 8 days abroad short enough to avoid tax/residency issues?

security-bot: Any cross-border remote work requires review. Ireland for <14 days usually doesn't create tax nexus, but Security needs the device plan (company laptop, VPN) and a quick risk assessment for EU data access. Add that to the mini-form.

payroll-bot: Use payroll code PARENT_PHASE. PTO accrual will be prorated based on scheduled FTE each pay period. Benefit premiums remain the same for up to 12 weeks of phased return for US-headquartered employees; country-specific policies may vary.

tom (Manager): Sounds fine in principle. Emily, please add a coverage note for your on-call rotation and any release dates. I'll approve once People Ops confirms payroll adjustments.

emily: Thanks — will add coverage notes and submit forms today. Quick Q: the team depends on one weekly demo Monday mornings; can I schedule my 40% Monday morning off?

tom (Manager): Prefer you keep that demo in your calendar and swap a different day off. If unavoidable, arrange a backup presenter.

finance-bot: FYI on stipends — you may apply for the Family Transition Stipend (up to $800) for childcare or legal costs tied to the ramp. Submit receipts within 30 days after ramp completes. Payment is post-approval. Also, base salary is pro-rated to actual hours during reduced FTE weeks.

emily: Is there a deadline to submit the phased form?

marc (People Ops): Please submit at least 10 business days before your first phased day to allow payroll and security reviews. For an 2026-08-02 start, submit ASAP.

emily: Submitted both forms and added the calendar coverage note. Tagged you @marc.

marc (People Ops): Got it. I'll fast-track review and loop Security if needed. Tom, please approve in portal when you get the manager sign-off request. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
